# Pieter Paul Castelein

> I am Pieter Paul Castelein, an operator and company builder based in Portugal. Through Skaler, I bring ideas, industry expertise, assets, customer access, capital, and exceptional people together to build new companies for the market ahead.

## English

- [Operator · Company builder | Pieter Paul Castelein](https://www.castelein.eu.com/): I am Pieter Paul Castelein, an operator and company builder based in Portugal. When intelligence and software become abundant, code alone ceases to be a lasting advantage.
- [What still matters when superintelligence arrives.](https://www.castelein.eu.com/thesis/): When intelligence and software become abundant, code alone ceases to be a lasting advantage. As AI, robotics, and superintelligence mature, traditional software boundaries fade.
- [Turn dormant assets and sector insight into future-proof operating companies.](https://www.castelein.eu.com/partnerships/): I partner with asset owners, industry experts, and aligned capital sources to build defensible operating companies around real-world or institutional advantages.
- [Structural analyses on the post-software landscape.](https://www.castelein.eu.com/memos/): When software development becomes faster and cheaper, what makes a new company in a traditional industry durable? The answer lies in the friction of the real world and owned channels.
- [Connecting foresight to practical execution.](https://www.castelein.eu.com/about/): I am Pieter Paul Castelein, an operator and company builder based in Portugal.
- [Discuss the Opportunity](https://www.castelein.eu.com/contact/): Tell me what could be built, who it would serve, and what you bring to the table. I welcome conversations with industry experts, established companies, investors, asset owners, and prospective founders.
- [Privacy](https://www.castelein.eu.com/privacy/): How personal information is handled on this website and when you contact Pieter Paul Castelein about an opportunity.
